name: OR-Tools Allergen-Aware Finite Production Scheduling and SAP PP/DS Dispatch
description: Formulate and solve a finite capacity production schedule on Aseptic Line 01 using Google OR-Tools CP-SAT, sequence non-allergenic oat milk before tree-nut almond milk, reduce changeover wash time by 5.0 hours, and dispatch schedule blocks to SAP PP/DS.
input_query: Sequence unscheduled production orders for Line 01 in SAP PP/DS, apply allergen changeover matrix, solve with OR-Tools CP-SAT to minimize CIP downtime, and dispatch locked blocks.

eval_models.orchestrator_routing: Agent Orchestrator dynamically decides whether to route the query to Gemini 3.8 Flash (gemini-3.8-flash) or escalate to Gemini 3.1 Pro / 4 Argon (gemini-3.1-pro / gemini-4-argon, subject to availability).
